claim: Test whether traversing the ordered polygon prefix once for the two pixels owned by a lane improves completed fixed-parameter engine throughput. Shared-load savings and hardware cost are unmeasured.

control.scope: Earlier same-session calibration only, not a fresh noise measurement and not A/B statistics. Same immutable executable/source/defaults/backend required. No correction or sample reuse.

gate_each_complete_phase.math: same compare.statistics paired log means, equal cases, stratified resampling

bounds.scope: One training lab; only a pass permits one all-five-workgroup numerical checker and three reserved lab workers. All serial and one total deadline.

stopping.valid_train_pass: Candidate-specific actual raster fixtures at all five public workgroups required before reserved timing; no extra training samples
stopping.all_pass: conditional performance candidate; independent audit and final exact source review before keeping shader

numerical_fixtures: Only after training passes: actual reference/candidate raster coverage, raw new/old RGB-byte-L1 and framebuffer-consistency fixtures across all five public workgroups, counts 0/1/194/255/256, partial tiles and edge cases. Use exact candidate/options; no oracle/comparison/tolerance changes. Existing T2/T4 hash-pinned checker does not qualify this source.
reserved_policy: Distinct mature drawings and fixed seeds, own reference qualification endpoints. Collect all three valid reserved matrices before statistical gate.
startup: Native setup timers retained separately, never added to completed-engine throughput; no application startup or isolation claim.
old_experiments: All previous cohorts remain closed and excluded. One-tile two-pixel loop fusion is independent of rejected tile grouping, layout, normalized-color, deferred-load and host prototypes. No composition or sample reuse. Original pixel-pair v1 is closed INCONCLUSIVE after SPIRV generation failure. This fresh v2 source uses scalar RGB pointer arguments; no v1 sample, output or qualification is reused.

hypothesis_evidence.mechanism: Keep shared cache and rasterize_blend text; one shared polygon fetch per pair before two independent ascending per-pixel blends. Only original integer errors are combined. No grid, host, resources, RNG or options changes.
hypothesis_evidence.limits: Mesa IR is not final NVIDIA ISA or dynamic memory cost; additional live per-pixel state may regress. Source FP preservation is not compiled FP equality.

review: Source-only original blend/one-pixel helpers and barriers retained; scalar RGB locals avoid the reproduced Naga struct-member pointer failure. All exact numerical, work and performance gates remain mandatory.

compiler_preflight.all_five_shapes: parse + full validation + SPIRV1.3 generation with zeroingNone; no GPU initialization
compiler_preflight.limitations: Default binding map/capabilities are not the complete adapter-specific descriptor. Compilation does not qualify GPU numerical equality or performance.

prior_closed_attempt.scope: Preserve original failure; v2 is separately frozen and receives one new native training invocation.
